content: व्यधिकरणम् Subsisting in different receptacles or substrata; (as in व्यधिकरणबहुव्रीहि which means ‘a Bahuvrīhi compound, the first member of which is not in apposition, or stands in a different case-relation, to the second, in the dissolution of the compound’; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} चक्रपाणिः, चन्द्रमौलिः <ab>&c.</ab>)
